headline: Last session: Indian benchmark indices extended their weekly rally with Sensex and Nifty reaching nine-month highs.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: India and the European Union are set to sign a landmark Free Trade Agreement on December 16.
Record Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) buying supported momentum in recent sessions.
Banking and IT sector stocks provided key support for market recovery during recent trading.
Global headlines reflected market stabilization efforts in South Korea and margin policy adjustments in China.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, due to the weekend.
Over recent trading sessions, Sensex and Nifty extended a four-week rally to hit nine-month highs.
The Labour Ministry launched a job-matching portal alongside an occupational shortage index.
Regular market trading operations will resume on Wednesday, 25 November 2026.
summary: The Indian equity market is closed today due to the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday. In recent trading sessions, Sensex and Nifty extended their four-week rally to reach nine-month highs, propelled by strong FII inflows and support from banking and IT stocks. Investors are also tracking upcoming trade catalysts, including the planned India-EU Free Trade Agreement in December.
